name: ig-comment-dm

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute ig-comment-dm --local --file=migrations/001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute ig-comment-dm --local --file=migrations/002_webhook_events.sql
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute ig-comment-dm --remote --file=migrations/001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute ig-comment-dm --remote --file=migrations/002_webhook_events.sql
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

description: Self-hosted Instagram comment-to-DM automation on a single Cloudflare Worker.
